steps.text: VERY IMPORTANT: If you want to make this alt into a slayer lure alt, DONT complete the following quests: Dragon Slayer 1, Priest in Peril, Elemental workshop 1, Contact!, Death Plateau, Olaf's quest, Cabin fever, Regicide and Desert Treasure

steps.title: your acc now has 75 quest …
steps.text: your acc now has 75 quest points if you followed the starter alt guide. you can complete a few easy quests to unlock the second block slot OR just do all your black demon tasks (takes longer and costs more)

steps.title: IF going for just 1 block …
steps.text: IF going for just 1 block you should do atleast Horror from the deep to unlock dagannoths as a slayer task
